certification_rule: no certificate work until exact full horizon is durable and validated; partial capture is non-certifying
process_epoch_identity_contract: worker initializer creates one random epoch nonce; process_epoch_id=sha256(pid,ppid,epoch_nonce); job identity excluded; duplicate process_epoch_id across observations fails closed
resume_rule: capture only contiguous precommitted indices; complete durable shard readback before next launch; any ambiguous launched-but-unrecorded observation invalidates this generation and is never retried
supersession_reason: v5 fresh_process_id embedded job identity and generated boot nonce per job, so uniqueness could not falsify worker-process reuse; v6 uses initializer-stable job-independent process epoch identity
trial_unit_contract: one distinct attempt_id, evaluated once in each of two distinct spawned worker process epochs; every observation process handles exactly one job and exits
